SRP Mobs can break different grades of Hardness, depending on the type of [[Mobs|Mob]] or Tier. 

Listed below are the Hardness Levels each Tier can break.

* [[:Category:Variants#Breacher_Variants|Breacher Variant]] Parasites have double the hardness breaking capabilities of their normal version.
* The [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''3'''
* [[Primitive Parasites]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''1'''
* [[Adapted Parasites]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''3'''
* The [[Adapted Bolster]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''3.5'''
* The [[Crux]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''4'''
* Stage I [[Nexus Parasites]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''3'''
* Stage II [[Nexus Parasites]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''5.5'''
* Stage III [[Nexus Parasites]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''7'''
* Stage IV [[Nexus Parasites]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''18'''
* The [[Sentry]] and [[Kyphosis]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''7'''
* [[Pure Parasites]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''5'''
* The [[Grunt]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''3'''
* [[Preeminent Parasites]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''15'''
* [[Ancient Parasites]] can break blocks up to a hardness of '''9'''
* [[Beckon|Beckons]] can infest blocks up to a hardness of '''4.5'''
* The [[Parasite Biome]] can corrupt blocks up to a Hardness of '''60'''

[https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Breaking#Blocks_by_hardness '''Click here'''] to see a list of the Hardness values for Vanilla Blocks.  Use this as a reference for building bases.

''Suggestion: Iron Bars, Iron Doors, and Metal Blocks cannot be infested by [[Beckon|Beckons]], and can only be broken by most above the Adapted Tier. However, no parasite can break Obsidian.''
